card.name: Just before a group size number
card.fires_on: The spot right before the number that gives how many subjects, animals or items are in a group, such as after "of", "n=" or a slash in a fraction. It also fires on the digits that begin such a count.

modes.label: Denominator in a count
modes.description: The space or symbol just before the total number in a fraction like "3 deaths out of 13,179".

modes.label: Sample size marker
modes.description: The "=" in n=15 or the start of a group count number.
modes.example: healthy subjects (n<<=>>15) did not significantly change IN

card.writes: It pushes toward a number (a count) and away from the word batch and similar words.
card.plain: It fires where a study group's size number is about to appear, like the total in "4 of 119 offspring".
